title: Airplane Seat Assignment Probability
summary: In an airplane with exactly n seats, the first passenger chooses a seat randomly.
statement: In an airplane with exactly n seats, the first passenger chooses a seat randomly. Each subsequent passenger will sit in their assigned seat if it is available, or select another seat randomly if their seat is occupied. Determine the probability that the last passenger will sit in their assigned seat.
constraints: Passenger one chooses a random seat; later passengers take their own seat when free and otherwise choose randomly.
There are exactly n passengers and seats.
Return the probability that the last passenger gets their assigned seat.
reference_solution:
def last_passenger_seat_probability(n):
    return 1.0 if n==1 else 0.5
hints: Only the first passenger’s seat and the last passenger’s seat matter as absorbing choices.
Intermediate displaced passengers preserve symmetry between those two outcomes.
Return one for n=1 and one half otherwise.
The random displacement chain ends at either special seat with equal probability.
editorial: The random displacement chain ends at either special seat with equal probability.

tests.explanation: The only passenger necessarily sits in the only assigned seat.
The first passenger chooses either seat equally, so the last succeeds with probability one half.
